Pankow Zentrum — Berlin, Germany

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Pankow Zentrum is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Pankow. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 7,497 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 2,959 cases recorded for the year, roughly 0.7× the citywide average, below it. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Wandroz currently rates Pankow Zentrum in Berlin, Germany as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz at night.
